grok-4-0709.reason: grok-4-0709 is xAI's API id for Grok 4 (released 2025-07-09, 256K context, per xAI docs and coverage); the index has no base Grok 4 entry (only the fast variants and later 4.x generations), so defer rather than link the wrong Grok.

kimi-k2-turbo-preview.reason: Moonshot's kimi-k2-turbo-preview, a preview checkpoint listed since Aug 2025 that aggregators variously describe as a fast serving of Kimi K2 or of the long-thinking K2; with no exact index entry and conflicting release dates, defer rather than link kimi-k2 or kimi-k2-thinking-turbo.

meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct-.reason: Abacus serves Meta's Llama 3.1 405B Instruct, with 'Turbo' a serving tier of the same checkpoint (128K context, 3.5/3.5); the index has no Llama 3.1 405B entry at all (only 8B/70B and later generations), so defer rather than link the wrong Llama.

route-llm.reason: Abacus.AI's RouteLLM: a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint where RouteLLM reads each prompt and picks the model from the 150+ model catalog that answers it best (per Abacus's FAQ); a router, not one fixed model.
